jobs.title: Program & Project Coordinator (5257C), Bakar ClimatEnginuity Hub - #89253
jobs.description:
Program & Project Coordinator (5257C), Bakar ClimatEnginuity Hub - #89253 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Bakar Labs is the consortium of biotech and climate tech incubators made up of four locations: Bakar Bio Labs at Berkeley, Bakar Bio Labs at UCSF, Bakar Labs for Energy and Materials, and the IGI-Bakar Labs Expansion.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
As Bakar Labs for Energy & Materials expands towards opening a new incubator facility in mid-2028, the Program & Project Coordinator works closely with a team of three to provide entrepreneurship programming and recruit early-stage energy and materials companies for a pilot program. This position applies project management and analytical skills to oversee the day-to-day administration and execution of Bakar Labs for Energy & Materials initiatives, including fellowship programs, events, workshops, and campus/industry partnerships.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
**The First Review Date for this job is:** October 16, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Program Operations & Administration - 35%
  
  
Manages day-to-day operational coordination of Bakar Labs programs, including developing and maintaining program systems, tracking milestones and deliverables, organizing scheduling across multiple concurrent activities, and managing founder and participant communications. Proactively identifies operational bottlenecks and implements process improvements to enhance program efficiency and participant experience.
  
  
Events & Workshop Management - 20%
  
  
Leads end-to-end logistical planning and execution of in-person and virtual events including founder workshops, speaker series, demo days, and community gatherings. Owns project timelines, vendor contracts, budget tracking, venue coordination, and post-event evaluation; applies findings to continuously improve event operations.
  
  
Partnerships & Campus Collaborations - 25%
  
  
Serves as primary operational point of contact for industry partners, sponsors, and campus collaborators including schools, departments, research centers, and student organizations. Manages deliverable tracking, maintains partner records, and coordinates stewardship touchpoints. Develops and maintains organizational systems to support relationship management across a portfolio of external and campus partners; coordinates joint activities and ensures commitments are met on time.
  
  
Fellowship Program Administration - 10%
  
  
Manages operational administration of fellowship winners and grantees including building and tracking ongoing progress, support and introductions, and managing program reports. Develops and refines operational workflows to support program scalability.
  
  
Project Management & Organizational Systems - 10%
  
  
Maintains and continuously improves project management infrastructure including tracking tools, dashboards, status reports, and documentation systems. Develops standardized templates and operational playbooks to support consistent program delivery. Supports leadership with data organization and reporting for strategic planning purposes.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to build and manage operational systems, workflows, and tracking tools across multiple concurrent programs and projects.
  
Proficiency with project management methodologies and tools (e.g. Asana, Notion, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or equivalent); ability to develop and maintain project plans, dashboards, and status reports.
  
Demonstrated ability to independently manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a high degree of operational autonomy.
  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with diverse audiences including startup founders, industry partners, campus collaborators, and university leadership.
  
Experience coordinating operational logistics for programs, events, or projects involving multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.
  
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with a wide range of internal and external partners including campus departments, research centers, and industry organizations.
  
Ability to identify process inefficiencies and develop practical, scalable operational improvements and standard operating procedures.
  
Proficiency with Google Workspace and common collaboration and productivity platforms.
  
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality with sensitive institutional, partner, and program information.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Familiarity with the startup, venture, or innovation ecosystem, particularly in deep tech, life sciences, or climate technology

jobs.title: AI Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake makes enterprise AI and data simple, secure, and scalable. Thousands of organizations worldwide rely on Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud to store, query, govern, and build intelligent applications on their most critical assets. As enterprises scale their data footprints and deploy autonomous AI agents, having high-quality, trusted, easily administered, and well-governed data has become foundational to enterprise survival and growth.

We are seeking an engineering executive to serve as the **Senior Director of Engineering for Horizon Catalog, Collaboration (Data Sharing, Native Apps, Zero Copy, Data Clean Rooms), and Snowflake Marketplace.**

This team brings together two pillars of the AI Data Cloud: Snowflake Horizon, the native governance, catalog, quality, and privacy engine, and Collaboration & Marketplace, the platforms that let organizations securely share, distribute, and monetize data, applications, and AI products. This engineering leadership role sits at a unique intersection: building planet-scale backend distributed systems while bringing deep product sensibility to the enterprise admin and data steward experience.

**In this role, you will lead an engineering organization responsible for:**

**1. Horizon Catalog & Metadata:** Building agentic experiences for exploring/understanding all the data estate and expressing governance intent, governance capabilities like data-quality monitoring and lineage tracking and integration with open standards (such as Apache Polaris / Iceberg REST catalog).

2. **Collaboration & Marketplace**: Building the sharing, application, and commerce platforms (Secure Data Sharing, Zero Copy, Native Apps, Data Clean Rooms, and Snowflake Marketplace) that connect providers and consumers across organizations, clouds, and regions.

3. **Managing data context:** Building capabilities like search and business ontology to help both humans and agents understand the semantics of their data.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* **Lead a Mission-Critical Organization:** Build, mentor, and inspire a world-class engineering organization including Engineering Directors, Senior Engineering Managers, and Principal Engineers across multiple hubs.
* **Bridge Engineering Depth with Product Intuition:** Combine world-class distributed systems engineering with sharp product understanding ensuring the capabilities your team builds are technically resilient, economically efficient, and intuitively packaged for the enterprise administrator and data engineer.
* **Build Next-Gen Data Quality Systems:** Spearhead the architecture for native data quality monitoring, automated data profiling, schema validation, and real-time alerts that catch data corruption or drift before it impacts downstream BI dashboards or AI models.
* **Power Enterprise Administration & Control:** Architect administrative tooling, tenant management control planes, and centralized policy orchestration that make managing Snowflake across hundreds of accounts and global regions simple and foolproof.
* **Scale Collaboration & Marketplace:** Lead the platforms behind secure data sharing, zero-copy partner integrations, Data Clean Rooms, and Snowflake Marketplace, the network that lets thousands of organizations share and monetize data, applications, and AI products across clouds and regions.
* **Drive Cross-Functional Alignment:** Collaborate closely with Product Management (PM), Design, and Security leaders to translate enterprise customer pain points into high-velocity execution roadmaps.
* **Customer & Operational Leadership:** Serve as an executive sponsor for tier-1 enterprise customers; champion operational excellence, security-by-design, and 99.99%+ availability across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience:** 15+ years of software engineering experience in product infrastructure, distributed systems, or enterprise cloud platforms, including 7+ years managing engineering directors, managers, and senior leaders across multi-team organizations.
* **Product-Minded Engineering Leadership:** Strong technical product acumen: you don't just build infrastructure in a vacuum. You deeply understand customer workflows, the enterprise admin persona, usability, and how technical architecture drives product adoption.
* **Distributed Systems at Scale:** Strong foundation in cloud-native distributed systems, high-throughput metadata storage, query execution, caching layers, and cross-region replication.
* **Organizational Excellence:** Proven ability to attract, hire, retain, and develop elite engineering talent; adept at fostering an inclusive, high-ownership engineering culture.
* **Executive Communication:** Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical architectures, trade-offs, and product strategies to VP/C-level leaders and enterprise customers.
* **Education:** B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Data Governance Depth**:** Prior experience with data governance frameworks, metadata management, automated lineage tracking, data classification (PII), or data masking/privacy controls.
* Experience building or operatin

jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  
  
Employee Experience and Productivity (EEP) is part of IS&T and delivers some of the most widely used communication and productivity technology and services across Apple - from tools that enable collaboration to the support teams that keep Apple's workforce running. EEP also leads user experience design and research, and manages the systems behind Apple's original content studios.  
  
**Description**  
  
Our team is looking for a program manager to join this dynamic and fast paced environment. This role will provide day-to-day support for the Employee Experience & Productivity team. This position will help drive and own projects related to finance, headcount, operations, financial planning and analysis deliverables. We’re looking for someone that is comfortable managing multi year budgets, able to think critically, and has top-level finance knowledge. This position requires not only complete financial analyses, but also the ability to drive tangible operational results both within and outside of the organization.

jobs.title: USG Capture Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

**USG Capture Operations Analyst**

The Capture Operations Analyst is the backbone of Astranis's US Government capture operations, working with both the business development team and capture team to ensure the smooth execution of pipeline management, marketing initiatives, and proposal activities. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, a strong communicator, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. The analyst will be instrumental in maintaining the integrity of Astranis's government opportunity pipeline, monitoring federal procurement portals for new business, and providing essential administrative and logistical support to drive our government growth strategy forward. In addition, the analyst will aid the capture team in developing proposal responses, briefing and marketing materials, and trade show organization and coordination.

**Role**

* **Pipeline & CRM Data Management:** Maintain and update the Astranis's Business Development pipeline and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. Ensure all opportunity data, contact information, and review statuses are accurate and current.
* **Solicitation Monitoring & Research:** Actively monitor federal procurement portals (e.g., SAM.gov, NASA Spires, etc.) for new solicitations, Requests for Information (RFIs), Sources Sought notices, and industry days relevant to Astranis's capabilities, disseminating findings to the appropriate Capture and BD leads.
* **Marketing & Communications Support:** Assist in drafting, editing, and producing customer responses and marketing materials tailored for US Government audiences. This includes capability statements, past performance summaries, product summaries, and presentations for customer meetings.
* **Proposal Management Assistance:** Support the Proposal Manager and Capture Manager during the proposal lifecycle. Assist with proposal management, compliance matrix development, data call coordination, section authoring, and logistical support for color team reviews.
* **Logistical & Event Coordination:** Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, and document action items for capture strategy sessions and executive gate reviews. Manage logistics and scheduling for industry events, trade shows, and customer site visits.

  

**Requirements**

* B.S. or B.A. in business administration, operations, or engineering
* 2-5 years of experience in business development support, technical sales, operations, or other administrative role, preferably within the government contracting sector.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with a demonstrated ability to juggle multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to draft professional marketing copy and correspond effectively with internal stakeholders.
* Hyper-focused attention to detail, particularly regarding data entry, document formatting, and compliance checking.
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed, up to 25% of time
* US Citizen or Green Card Holder

**Bonus**

* B.S. in engineering or B.A. in business
* Familiarity with standard federal government procurement processes, terminology (e.g., RFI, RFP, RPP), and portals (SAM.gov)
* Federal-level capture/proposal execution and/or government acquisition experience
* Previous exposure to standard proposal development processes (e.g., Shipley Associates methodology)
* Working knowledge and interest in satellites, US government space missions (both civil and national security space)
* Eligible to obtain a TS/SCI Security Clearance
* Less than 5 years since previously active TS//SCI Security Clearance

**U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required**

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

* **Recruiting Updates:** By opting in, you agree to receive SMS updates, interview coordination, and recruiting communications from Astranis Space Technologies Corp.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Operations Manager to lead and optimize daily business functions across our retail locations. This pivotal role involves overseeing store operations, managing teams, and ensuring exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate will be passionate about retail management, possess strong leadership skills, and have a comprehensive understanding of operational processes including inventory control, sales management, and staff training. Your energetic approach will drive store performance, foster a positive work environment, and ensure operational excellence at every level.

**Duties**

* Lead and supervise retail staff, including hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing development to cultivate a high-performing team.
* Oversee daily store operations such as cash handling, POS system management, merchandising, stocking, and inventory control to ensure smooth workflow.
* Manage sales strategies by monitoring retail sales performance, setting targets, and implementing promotional activities to boost revenue.
* Coordinate purchasing and pricing decisions to maintain optimal stock levels while controlling costs and maximizing profitability.
* Conduct employee orientation sessions and facilitate ongoing training on customer service excellence, product knowledge, and operational procedures.
* Implement effective management of payroll, bookkeeping, budgeting, and administrative tasks to support store efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and legal regulations while maintaining excellent customer service standards.
* Utilize strong communication skills to manage shift schedules, supervise cashiering activities, and handle customer inquiries professionally.
* Drive marketing initiatives within the store to attract customers and increase sales through merchandising and promotional campaigns.
* Maintain organized records of inventory levels, sales data, employee performance metrics, and operational reports for continuous improvement.

**Experience**

* Proven management experience within the retail industry with a focus on sales team supervision and store operations management.
* Demonstrated proficiency in inventory management systems (POS systems), purchasing processes, and retail math for accurate pricing and stock control.
* Strong background in recruiting, interviewing candidates, employee orientation, training & development programs.
* Experience with payroll processing, bookkeeping practices, budgeting responsibilities, and cash handling procedures.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Bilingual or multilingual abilities are preferred to serve diverse customer bases effectively.
* Supervising experience in retail sales teams with a focus on customer service excellence is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with wireless sales or grocery store operations is a plus but not required.

Join us as an Operations Manager if you’re ready to lead with energy, inspire your team’s growth, and make a tangible impact on our store’s success!

Pay: $45.00 - $60.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, M&A Carveouts & Integration
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead carveout and integration programs for PE-backed clients. You will run the program from signing through Day 1 and TSA exit. That means coordinating buyer, seller, and functional workstreams so the new standalone business operates cleanly and on schedule. This is a client-facing role. You will work directly with deal teams, operating partners, and portfolio company executives. M&A Carveout experience is a MUST!!

**What You'll Do**

* Lead end-to-end carveout programs: separation planning, Day 1 readiness, TSA stand-up, and TSA exit
* Build and manage the integrated program plan, critical path, RAID log, and governance cadence (IMO/SMO)
* Coordinate across cross-functional workstreams, including Finance, Legal, IT, and Operations
* Directly manage the ERP and HR/Payroll workstreams in partnership with the workstream leads
* Define and track TSA scope, service schedules, costs, and exit milestones with buyer and seller
* Drive Day 1 planning, including cutover plans, command center setup, and go/no-go decisions
* Identify and escalate risks and dependencies early, with clear mitigation options
* Produce executive-level status reporting for PE sponsors and portfolio leadership
* Manage third-party vendors and system integrators supporting separation activities

**What You Bring**

* 8+ years of program or project management experience, with 3+ years focused on M&A
* Hands-on leadership of at least two carveouts, including TSA negotiation, management, and exit
* Experience in a PE-backed environment or advisory firm (Big 4, A&M, or similar) strongly preferred
* Working knowledge of ERP, application, and HR/Payroll separation
* Strong command of governance, financial tracking, and stakeholder management under tight deal timelines
* Ability to operate independently and stay calm in ambiguous, fast-moving situations
* Excellent written and verbal communication with C-suite and sponsor audiences
* PMP, PgMP, or similar certification a plus

Pay: $125.00 - $175.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Program Manager HCM (Workday)
jobs.description:
**Location and Remote Eligibility**

Fully remote candidates within the United States will be considered if they demonstrate substantial experience leading large-scale Workday implementations as a project manager, program manager, engagement manager, or delivery lead.

At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.

**Position Description**
========================

Connect Centric is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) initiatives for our client, with a primary focus on UKG and Workday. You will oversee multiple HCM workstreams, connecting implementation plans, platform enhancements, integrations, reporting, governance, and operational readiness across the program.  
  
This role requires direct experience supporting both UKG and Workday initiatives.

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Lead complex, cross-functional HCM programs and projects involving UKG, Workday, and related workforce management capabilities.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans, implementation roadmaps, schedules, milestones, budgets, dependencies, risks, and issues across HCM workstreams.
* Facilitate program governance and decision forums; prepare decision materials, document decisions, track actions, and provide status updates to senior leaders.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders, vendors, and workstream project managers to clarify scope, align priorities, resolve risks and issues, and maintain delivery momentum.
* Coordinate requirements, configuration decisions, business workflows, integrations, data validation, testing, and implementation readiness for UKG and Workday initiatives.
* Oversee cutover coordination, operational transition planning, and post-implementation stabilization across the HCM program.
* Prepare executive reports, dashboards, decision logs, and risk, assumption, issue, and dependency (RAID) logs; communicate delivery progress, tradeoffs, decisions, and adoption impacts.
* Support HCM process improvement, change management, stakeholder readiness, training coordination, and adoption planning.
* Develop and maintain program standards, templates, governance routines, tools, and delivery methodologies that improve consistency and readiness.
* Assess workforce processes, platform issues, data considerations, vendor capabilities, and platform roadmaps; recommend practical solutions to complex HCM challenges.
* Ensure work products meet business needs, quality expectations, compliance requirements, data integrity standards, configuration expectations, and delivery commitments.
* Balance competing HCM programs, platform enhancements, implementation activities, and stakeholder needs.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree and at least eight years of experience in program management, project management, business analysis, technology delivery, or a related field, including demonstrated experience supporting enterprise HCM platforms.
* Strong experience supporting both UKG and Workday initiatives, including implementation planning, enhancements, requirements definition, configuration coordination, business process alignment, and integration coordination.
* Experience coordinating HCM testing, data validation, security and access considerations, reporting, stakeholder readiness, training support, adoption, issue resolution, and post-implementation stabilization.
* Hands-on experience using UKG and Workday to support program delivery, platform reporting, issue tracking, stakeholder communications, governance, testing coordination, cutover planning, and executive decision support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex HCM programs or projects involving HR, payroll, finance, operations, technology teams, vendors, and senior leaders.
* Working knowledge of core HR, payroll, time and attendance, absence management, benefits, talent, workforce scheduling, reporting, and employee self-service processes.
* Strong understanding of scope, schedule, budget, risk, issue, dependency, resource, change, benefits, and stakeholder management.
* Experience supporting Agile or other delivery methodologies in enterprise platform, ERP, HRIS, payroll, workforce management, or HCM environments.
* Experience preparing and presenting executive reports, dashboards, status updates, decision materials, risk summaries, and implementation readiness updates.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Agile, Scrum, Prosci, ITIL, Workday, UKG, HRIS, or a similar certification.

**Position Details**

* Position Type: Full-time W-2 employment. Independent contractor or 1099 arrangements are not available for this position.
* Location: Washington D.C. / Remote for Exceptional Candidates outside of commuting radius.
* This position is hybrid (2x per week)
* Pay Rate: $130K - $140K

As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.  
  
Position Description  
Connect Centric is seeking a Project Manager to manage the payroll workstream within our client’s enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) initiatives, with a primary focus on UKG and Workday. You will plan, coordinate, and track payroll deliverables, schedules, requirements, risks, testing, implementation readiness, cutover, and operational transition.  
  
This role requires direct experience supporting payroll initiatives involving both UKG and Workday. Working under the direction of the client’s Project Management Office (PMO) Manager, you will partner with payroll, HR, finance, operations, IT, the Senior Program Manager, vendors, and implementation partners to deliver payroll outcomes that meet business needs, compliance requirements, and enterprise technology standards.  
  
What You Will Do  

* Lead planning and execution tracking for the payroll workstream across UKG, Workday, and related workforce management initiatives.
* Develop, maintain, and track payroll workstream plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, action items, and implementation activities.
* Facilitate payroll workstream meetings; prepare materials, document decisions, track follow-up actions, and communicate progress to stakeholders and leadership.
* Coordinate with payroll, HR, finance, operations, IT, the Senior Program Manager, vendors, and implementation partners to clarify scope, align priorities, and resolve risks and issues.
* Coordinate payroll requirements, configuration decisions, business workflows, integrations, data validation, testing, and implementation readiness for UKG and Workday.
* Support payroll cutover, implementation, transition planning, and post-implementation stabilization.
* Maintain dashboards, status reports, decision logs, risk, assumption, issue, and dependency (RAID) logs, action trackers, and other payroll project documentation.
* Communicate payroll delivery status, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, compliance considerations, and adoption impacts to leadership and affected teams.
* Support payroll process improvement, change management, stakeholder readiness, training coordination, and adoption planning.
* Apply client-approved project standards, templates, governance routines, and delivery methods; follow client policies, confidentiality expectations, information security requirements, and applicable compliance standards.
* Assess payroll operations, workforce processes, data considerations, platform roadmaps, and vendor capabilities to recommend practical solutions and improvements.
* Help ensure deliverables meet business needs, quality expectations, compliance requirements, data integrity standards, configuration expectations, and delivery commitments while balancing enhancements, stakeholder requests, and deadlines.

  
Required Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree and at least five years of experience providing business analysis, technology delivery, and senior project management support for enterprise HCM or payroll platform initiatives.
* Experience supporting payroll initiatives involving both UKG and Workday, including project planning, enhancements, requirements definition, configuration coordination, payroll workflow alignment, and integration coordination.
* Experience coordinating payroll testing, data validation, security and access considerations, reporting, readiness, training support, adoption, issue resolution, and post-implementation stabilization.
* Hands-on experience using UKG and Workday to support payroll workstream delivery, project reporting, issue tracking, stakeholder communications, implementation and testing coordination, cutover planning, and decision support.
* Experience supporting complex payroll or HCM workstreams involving payroll, HR, finance, operations, technology teams, vendors, implementation partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of payroll operations, payroll compliance requirements, time and attendance, absence management, benefits, workforce scheduling, reporting, and employee self-service.
* Strong understanding of scope, schedule, budget, risk, issue, escalation protocols, dependency, resource, change, benefits, and stakeholder management.
* Experience supporting Agile or other delivery methodologies in enterprise platform, ERP, HRIS, payroll, workforce management, or HCM environments.
* Ability to work with stakeholders to define payroll and HCM solutions, delivery approaches, project decisions, and operational readiness plans, and to interpret vendor feedback and recommend actions.
* Experience preparing and presenting project reports, dashboards, status updates, decision materials, risk summaries, and payroll implementation readiness updates.
* Strong planning, organization, facilitation, analysis, problem-solving, and time management skills, with excellent documentation and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex payroll and HCM concepts, risks, tradeoffs, and implementation impacts to business stakeholders and leadership.

new_jobs.title: USG Capture Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

**USG Capture Operations Analyst**

The Capture Operations Analyst is the backbone of Astranis's US Government capture operations, working with both the business development team and capture team to ensure the smooth execution of pipeline management, marketing initiatives, and proposal activities. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, a strong communicator, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. The analyst will be instrumental in maintaining the integrity of Astranis's government opportunity pipeline, monitoring federal procurement portals for new business, and providing essential administrative and logistical support to drive our government growth strategy forward. In addition, the analyst will aid the capture team in developing proposal responses, briefing and marketing materials, and trade show organization and coordination.

**Role**

* **Pipeline & CRM Data Management:** Maintain and update the Astranis's Business Development pipeline and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. Ensure all opportunity data, contact information, and review statuses are accurate and current.
* **Solicitation Monitoring & Research:** Actively monitor federal procurement portals (e.g., SAM.gov, NASA Spires, etc.) for new solicitations, Requests for Information (RFIs), Sources Sought notices, and industry days relevant to Astranis's capabilities, disseminating findings to the appropriate Capture and BD leads.
* **Marketing & Communications Support:** Assist in drafting, editing, and producing customer responses and marketing materials tailored for US Government audiences. This includes capability statements, past performance summaries, product summaries, and presentations for customer meetings.
* **Proposal Management Assistance:** Support the Proposal Manager and Capture Manager during the proposal lifecycle. Assist with proposal management, compliance matrix development, data call coordination, section authoring, and logistical support for color team reviews.
* **Logistical & Event Coordination:** Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, and document action items for capture strategy sessions and executive gate reviews. Manage logistics and scheduling for industry events, trade shows, and customer site visits.

  

**Requirements**

* B.S. or B.A. in business administration, operations, or engineering
* 2-5 years of experience in business development support, technical sales, operations, or other administrative role, preferably within the government contracting sector.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with a demonstrated ability to juggle multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to draft professional marketing copy and correspond effectively with internal stakeholders.
* Hyper-focused attention to detail, particularly regarding data entry, document formatting, and compliance checking.
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed, up to 25% of time
* US Citizen or Green Card Holder

**Bonus**

* B.S. in engineering or B.A. in business
* Familiarity with standard federal government procurement processes, terminology (e.g., RFI, RFP, RPP), and portals (SAM.gov)
* Federal-level capture/proposal execution and/or government acquisition experience
* Previous exposure to standard proposal development processes (e.g., Shipley Associates methodology)
* Working knowledge and interest in satellites, US government space missions (both civil and national security space)
* Eligible to obtain a TS/SCI Security Clearance
* Less than 5 years since previously active TS//SCI Security Clearance

**U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required**

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

#### **Astranis SMS Terms of Service**

* **Recruiting Updates:** By opting in, you agree to receive SMS updates, interview coordination, and recruiting communications from Astranis Space Technologies Corp.

* **Opt-Out:** You can cancel this service at any time by replying **STOP**. We will send one final text confirming your unsubscription.

* **Opt-In Again:** To resume receiving messages, reply **START** or **YES**.

* **Support & Rates:** For assistance, reply **HELP** or contact us at coordinators@astranis.com. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies; carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

* **Privacy:** For details on how we protect your data, view our Privacy Policy.

new_jobs.description:

* Lead end-to-end carveout programs: separation planning, Day 1 readiness, TSA stand-up, and TSA exit

* Define and track TSA scope, service schedules, costs, and exit milestones with buyer and seller
* Drive Day 1 planning, including cutover plans, command center setup, and go/no-go decisions
* Identify and escalate risks and dependencies early, with clear mitigation options
* Produce executive-level status reporting for PE sponsors and portfolio leadership
* Manage third-party vendors and system integrators supporting separation activities

**What You Bring**

* 8+ years of program or project management experience, with 3+ years focused on M&A
* Hands-on leadership of at least two carveouts, including TSA negotiation, management, and exit
* Experience in a PE-backed environment or advisory firm (Big 4, A&M, or similar) strongly preferred
* Working knowledge of ERP, application, and HR/Payroll separation
* Strong command of governance, financial tracking, and stakeholder management under tight deal timelines
* Ability to operate independently and stay calm in ambiguous, fast-moving situations
* Excellent written and verbal communication with C-suite and sponsor audiences
